title: Aligning to Social Norms and Values in Interactive Narratives
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not specifically measure any aspects of faith or religion. It focuses on general social and moral norms, such as theft, bodily harm, and altruism, within interactive game scenarios.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it is not a focus of the research.
